part.text:
The fix is validated. Summary:

- **Root cause**: `HandleFieldDefaults.visitType` applied the `lombok.fieldDefaults.defaultPrivate/defaultFinal` config flags to all non-interface types, including records, which then hit the `isClassOrEnum` check and errored with `@FieldDefaults is only supported on a class or an enum.`
- **Fix**: Records are now skipped when no explicit `@FieldDefaults` annotation is present (same treatment as interfaces/annotations):
  - src/core/lombok/javac/handlers/HandleFieldDefaults.java:138 — added `RECORD` (from `lombok.javac.Javac`) to the early-return flag check
  - src/core/lombok/eclipse/handlers/HandleFieldDefaults.java:157 — added `Eclipse.AccRecord` to the equivalent check
- **Tests**: `ant test.instance` — `FieldDefaultsViaConfigOnRecord` now passes (was failing at baseline), and the explicit-annotation error case `FieldDefaultsOnRecord` still passes. Only 4 pre-existing, unrelated record-test failures remain (same as baseline).
